description: Execution contract for qualitative, case-study and design-based inquiry. Its method is sampling, data generation, coding and interpretation, with alternative interpretations and credibility checks including reflexivity. Its findings are themes, patterns, interpretations, explanations or (for design-based research) design principles, each traceable to the material it rests on. It uses no statistical significance, regression robustness or causal identification as a default standard. A manuscript may present findings as a section of any name. Independent of discipline. Status EXTRACTED: order and conditions only.

contribution.activity: stating what the inquiry could add

literature.activity: positioning the inquiry in prior work
literature.manuscript: background, or woven into the findings

methods.activity: sampling, data generation, coding and interpretation, and the checks of credibility
methods.manuscript: a method section, or a methodological account within the study

results.activity: the findings: themes, patterns, interpretations, explanations or design principles, each traceable to the material it rests on
results.manuscript: findings, analysis or case sections, in prose and excerpts; no coefficients are implied

discussion.activity: interpretation, transferability and the researcher's role in the findings

steps.title: Position the inquiry in prior work (a landscape of it, or the researcher's recorded account)
Sampling rationale: why these participants, cases or iterations

on_condition.reason: interpretations were still changing as data were added: generate more data before settling them

steps.title: Credibility checks, including reflexivity about the researcher's role
Set out the findings: themes, patterns, interpretations or explanations (the research product)
Check that each finding can be traced to the material it rests on

evidence_requirements.about: excerpts or other material the findings rest on

steps.title: State the design principles the iterations support (design-based research)

applicability.justification: only design-based research states design principles

steps.title: Transferability of the findings and the researcher's role in them (recorded)
